name: flex_extract
role: Normative oracle for the preprocessing of the ECMWF eta-coordinate vertical velocity (deta/dt, GRIB parameter 77) into the pressure vertical velocity in Pa/s consumed by FLEXPART as omega (flex_extract calc_etadot, regular-grid META=1, METADIFF=0, MOMEGA=0, MDPDETA=1 configuration).

build.make_arguments: LIB='-Bstatic -leccodes_f90_static -leccodes_static -Bdynamic -lemosR64 -lm -lpng -laec -lopenjp2' (overrides the makefile_fast default -Bstatic -leccodes_f90 -leccodes because the flexpart-fortran container ships the ecCodes static archives under the postfixed names libeccodes_f90_static.a / libeccodes_static.a; -lemosR64 stays in the link because calc_etadot calls the EMOSLIB spectral routines set90/set99/jsspol/fft99 via grphreal/phgrreal/ftrafo; -lopenjp2 -laec -lpng supply the transitive static-link dependencies of eccodes and jasper)
build.verified_in_container: flex-extract:latest (built from flexpart-fortran:latest; gfortran 11.4.0, Ubuntu 22.04) + apt packages libemos-dev libemos-bin libemos-data libopenjp2-7-dev; calc_etadot_fast.out links and the official Calc_etadot installation example runs to 'STOP SUCCESSFULLY FINISHED'

required_inputs.fort.4: NAMGEN namelist; oracle configuration META=1, METADIFF=0, MOMEGA=0, MDPDETA=1, MOMEGADIFF=0
required_inputs.fort.10: horizontal wind components u (GRIB parameter 131) and v (132) on model levels (required by the shared read path; not used by the META=1/MDPDETA=1 transform)
required_inputs.fort.11: temperature (GRIB parameter 130) on model levels; also the GRIB message that the fort.15 output is modeled on
required_inputs.fort.12: logarithm of surface pressure ln(ps) (GRIB parameter 152) in spectral (SH) representation plus the vertical coordinate coefficients pv (A/B half levels)
required_inputs.fort.17: specific humidity (GRIB parameter 133) on model levels
required_inputs.fort.21: raw eta-coordinate vertical velocity deta/dt (GRIB parameter 77) on model levels

optional_inputs.fort.13: divergence D (GRIB parameter 155); NOT read in the META=1/METADIFF=0 oracle configuration
optional_inputs.fort.16/18/19/22: omega/smoothing auxiliary files used only by other configurations

outputs.fort.15: FLEXPART-ready GRIB containing the transformed pressure vertical velocity parameter 77 (read as 135 by FLEXPART) on MLEVELIST half-level boundaries

source_requirement: Reference checkouts must be unmodified upstream sources at exactly the pinned commit. Any deviation (different commit, dirty work tree) fails verification.
notes: calc_etadot.f90 at v7.1.2 is identified by git blob 741eba91eab049df23a560219d0f2656a6cc9881. The canonical blob bytes (LF line endings as stored by Git) hash to sha256 160F267F8741F23D13FDBA2F7A88F110BB131AA84AD7894FA43605258E55B0D9. Comparison harnesses verify the Git blob and hash canonical bytes from git show, so core.autocrlf cannot change the oracle fingerprint, then cross-check the source-snippet contract of the ETAR transform block (calc_etadot.f90 lines 541-557).
Vertical coordinate convention: AK=BK come from fort.12 pv, top-of-atmosphere half level first (ECMWF ordering); candidates express the same coefficients in canonical interface order index 0 = top.

The makefile_fast link line and include path target a machine with emoslib and a gfortran-15 module directory; the container environment overrides LIB (ecCodes static archives are postfixed _static in this image and EMOSLIB provides the spectral transforms) and pins INC to the container eccodes Fortran module directory (/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/fortran/gfortran-mod-15, which exists in flexpart-fortran:latest). The extra apt packages libemos-dev/libemos-bin/libemos-data/libopenjp2-7-dev must be installed in the running container (libemosR64.a ships with libemos-dev, variant R64.D64.I32).

fort.15 output field for the pressure vertical velocity carries parameter METAPAR (default 77); FLEXPART 11.1 readwind_ecmwf maps parameter 77 to 135 and feeds it as omega into wwh before the pinmconv geometric transform.

The official Testing/Installation/Calc_etadot example (MLEVEL 91, MLEVELIST 88/to/91, 6x6 regular_ll, lat 50..40 N, lon 30..40 E) was run with the verified container build through fe_build (Ubuntu 22.04, gfortran 11.4). It stops with 'STOP SUCCESSFULLY FINISHED calc_etadot', fort.15 = 21987 bytes (messages 77/134/130 on levels 88-91 plus 130 level 1), fort.21 carries the raw param-77 field, fort.12 the 184-element pv (92 A + 92 B). The end-to-end candidate (eta_dot_to_pressure_velocity, mdpdeta=1) matches the oracle field over all 36 grid points x 4 levels with worst relative error 1.03e-05 (f32 vs -fdefault-real-8 rounding) and worst absolute error 2.5e-08 Pa/s.
